_about: The shape and effect settings: each one's CSS variable, unit, limits, step (how far the arrows move it), label and help.

radius_selector.label: Small corner radius
radius_selector.help: Checkboxes, toggles and badges. 0 is square.

radius_field.label: Field corner radius
radius_field.help: Buttons, inputs, selects and tabs. 0 is square.

radius_box.label: Box corner radius
radius_box.help: Cards, alerts, modals and other boxes. 0 is square.

size_selector.label: Small control size
size_selector.help: Base size of checkboxes, toggles and badges (daisyUI uses 0.1875–0.3125).

size_field.label: Field size
size_field.help: Base size of buttons and inputs (daisyUI uses 0.1875–0.3125).

depth.label: Depth
depth.help: A subtle 3D shadow on buttons and other controls.

noise.label: Noise
noise.help: A subtle grain texture on controls.
